evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.text: Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.
Innate: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath ... stacking up to 120 times. ... At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.
sources_quoted.note: Pins the meaning of the '120' in the scenario id: the max-splinter (Transcendence) variant of the Syndra module's splinter option.

sources_quoted.text: Q Dark Sphere 90/125/160/195/230 (+70% AP); W Force of Will 70/100/130/160/190 (+65% AP), 60-splinter bonus true damage 12% (+2% per 100 AP); E Scatter the Weak 60/95/130/165/200 (+60% AP)

E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres). All five slots modeled with sourced numbers.
m(R) = 100 / (100 + R)   (apply_resistance, resistance.py); post = raw * m(R)
A part with h identical hits is mitigated per hit and summed: sum_h m(R)*raw = h*m(R)*raw ... exact because the mitigation operator x -> x*100/(100+R) is linear in raw damage for a fixed resistance.
Stat rounding (calculate_total_stats): display-level integer rounding of health/AD/AP/armor/MR before damage.

method.limitation: The golden scenario's own configuration (level, item/AP total, target resistances, the custom cast order) lives in scripts/ and tests/, which this runbook forbids reading. The exported data/ tree contains no scenario tuple for 'syndra_custom_order_120' (checked data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json and every data/worklists/* file). A direct forward evaluation is therefore not available; the computation below is a constraint solve: both the old and the new leaf must be Syndra damage events produced by ONE configuration (same effective AP A, same post-penetration MR, hence the same mitigation multiplier m = 100/(100+MR)).
method.constraint: new/old = 638.5 / 164.7 = 3.87675. Because m cancels, this fixes the ratio of the two RAW ability rows.
method.search: Enumerated every Syndra damage row from the cached wiki leveling arrays (Q ranks 1-5, W magic ranks 1-5, E ranks 1-5, R ranks 1-3 x 1..7 spheres), solved each ordered pair for the AP value that reproduces the ratio 3.87675, and kept solutions with AP >= 0 and 0.2 <= m <= 1 (MR >= 0). Repeated the sweep with the 120-splinter +15% AP buff applied to the post-fix side only.

independent_computation.result: In EVERY self-consistent solution, the larger value (638.5) is an Unleashed Power multi-sphere barrage and the smaller value (164.7) is a single Q/W/E nuke (or a single sphere). No solution exists in the other direction.

worked_example_the_only_integer_AP_solut.config: level 18 (Q5/W5/E5/R3), effective AP = 164 (i.e. 143 base AP x 1.15 Transcendence, rounded per the stat-rounding convention), post-penetration MR = 81.18
worked_example_the_only_integer_AP_solut.new_leaf_as_R: per sphere = 160 + 0.20 x 164 = 192.8 ; 6 spheres (3 conjured + 3 grabbed, inside the wiki's 3..7 band) = 1156.8 raw ; 1156.8 x 0.551944 = 638.49 -> 638.5
worked_example_the_only_integer_AP_solut.cross_check_against_wiki_rows: at AP 164 the wiki's own R rank-3 aggregate rows are min (3 spheres) 480 + 60% AP = 578.4 and max (7 spheres) 1120 + 140% AP = 1349.6; the 1156.8 raw used above lies inside that band, as it must.

exclusion_bounds.164.7_cannot_be_the_R_barrage: The smallest possible rank-3 Unleashed Power barrage is the wiki's Minimum Magic Damage row, 480 + 60% AP, i.e. >= 480 raw at 0 AP. Post-mitigation 164.7 then demands m <= 0.3431, i.e. post-penetration MR >= 191.4 - outside any ordinary Summoner's Rift target. So 164.7 is not a well-formed Unleashed Power value for a level-18 (rank 3) Syndra.
exclusion_bounds.638.5_cannot_be_a_single_nuke_in_the_sam: As a single nuke, 638.5 post-mitigation needs raw >= 638.5 even at MR = 0: E rank 5 would need AP >= 730.8, Q rank 5 would need AP >= 583.6. In the configuration that reproduces the old 164.7 for a single nuke (AP ~ 18-372, MR ~ 28-157), no single nuke can reach 638.5.
exclusion_bounds.no_R_to_R_explanation: R rank 3 with N spheres -> M spheres gives an integer ratio M/N (or, with the +15% AP Transcendence buff applied on one side only, a ratio strictly greater than M/N). 3.87675 is neither, so the pair cannot be the same R row at two sphere counts - the change is an identity change at index 3, not a sphere-count retune.

independent_computation.conclusion: damage_events[3] is the Unleashed Power barrage. 638.5 is the value a correct Unleashed Power row produces (rank 3, 5-7 spheres, ordinary AP/MR); 164.7 is a single-nuke-magnitude number that no correct rank-3 Unleashed Power row can produce short of ~191 post-penetration MR. The new value is the correct one.

residual_uncertainty: Because the scenario tuple is outside the permitted evidence tree, the identity of damage_events[3] is inferred (from the pair-consistency solve plus the natural Q/W/E/R event order of a four-cast rotation) rather than read. If damage_events[3] were in fact a single Q/W/E nuke - which would require the corrected 120-splinter run to place an extra event (e.g. the 40-splinter second Dark Sphere charge) before it AND the new value to be an R barrage misfiled at index 3 - the verdict would flip. The pair-consistency solve rules out every reading in which 164.7 is the R barrage, which is why the verdict is new_value_correct rather than old_value_correct or both_wrong.
